disposition_reason: Table 2 prints total (microwave digestion) K, Na, Mg, Ca, Mn, Zn, Fe and Cu, and Cd below LOD, in one uniced and one iced gingerbread product.

study.design: Analytical methods study (green-solvent extraction versus microwave digestion) on two commercial gingerbread products
study.method: Microwave-assisted acid digestion and ultrasound-assisted deep eutectic solvent extraction; ICP-MS (Agilent 7800, He collision mode)
study.qa: INCT-PVTL-6 tobacco leaves CRM for ICP-MS recovery

findings.group: product from a local confectionery company, MW-AD total digestion
findings.notes: One uniced and one iced gingerbread product from a local confectionery company (Poland), milled to powder; microwave-assisted acid digestion (MW-AD) then ICP-MS (Agilent 7800); mean ± SD of n=2 preparations. Basis as sold powder (not stated as dried). DES-extract values in the same table measure extractable fractions with test solvents and were not recorded as content.
